purpose: Test a parameter-free finite-sample zero-failure hedge after sequence 111 falsified treating observed 8/8 direct success as sufficient evidence for a no-fallback direct arm.
nonfitting_statement: No parameter, threshold, model, workload target, seed or acceptance gate below is fitted to or simulated on sequence-111 confirmation rows. The only inherited information is the falsified mechanism class: finite calibration can observe zero failures despite nonzero future failure probability.

statistical_basis.principle: A finite binomial sample with zero observed failures does not establish true success probability 1.0; small-sample binomial confidence procedures such as Wilson/Agresti-Coull explicitly retain nonzero uncertainty at an observed proportion of 1.

selector_rules.callex_v1: maximize calibration deadline-success rate, then minimize calibration mean capped time, then tie priority direct/fixed/conditional
selector_rules.cal_zfh_v1: start from the same max calibration success set. If maximal success is exactly 1.0 and both direct and conditional are in that max-success set, exclude direct because finite zero failures do not justify dropping the available fallback. Then minimize mean capped time among remaining max-success arms; remaining exact tie priority fixed/conditional/direct. Otherwise use the original max-success then mean-time ordering.

anes96_alt_needed.features: all bundled ANES96 columns except vote

star98_direct_good.features: all bundled Star98 columns except NABOVE/NBELOW

measurement.timing: sum of time.perf_counter_ns fit+predict around each of 3 folds
measurement.order: persist/readback exact harness+precommit -> environment -> all calibration raw -> persist/readback three snapshots -> all confirmation raw -> persist/readback raw -> exactly one confirmation simulation

candidate_rule.every_panel_success_and_cost_competitive: for each calibration snapshot, pooled ZFH confirmation success must be >= pooled CAL-LEX-v1 success; and ZFH mean capped time must be <=1.05x the fastest universal arm whose confirmation success is >= ZFH success (automatic pass if no universal arm is as successful); and the ZFH scenario choices must use >=2 distinct arms

no_retune_rule: After the first calibration timing, any defect or failed gate is a negative result. Do not alter selector rule, workload, target, model, seed, cap/deadline constant, or acceptance gate; any repair requires a new selector/adapter version and entirely fresh seeds.
